summary: It is White's move, and White takes the ko first. After White A16 and Black E19, White's capture at B19 threatens to take four stones at A18 at once. Black's retake at C19 still needs one approach (D16 or A15) before it threatens anything. That is A-1KO-: Black needs two threats more than White and fails with one, so the tree's A-1KO+ (Black first, one threat more) is wrong. Taking at B19 at once, or playing A15 first, gives White the same count of 2.
